scenes.h1: Do you read the Quran every day?
scenes.sub: Assalamu alaikum. Do you read the Quran every day?
Allah praises those who recite His Book and pray: they hope for a trade that will never fail.

chips: At the same time each day
scenes.sub: A few verses every day, even five minutes, keeps you close to the Quran.
Our teachers help children take small steps, with a report after every class.
